title: Grocery Store Villains: If one more meeting that should've been a meme, we need to talk about grocery store villain
caption:
If one more meeting that should've been a meme, we need to talk about grocery store villain

You've seen every one of these. Denial is free:
1️⃣ The Cart Architect — Parks sideways in the only aisle you need. Steps away to browse 47 varieties of the same cracker.
2️⃣ The 13-Item Express — Thirteen items, two coupons, one expired loyalty card, and a phone call about a plumbing crisis.
3️⃣ The Sample Siege — Forty minutes, nine toothpicks, zero purchases. The sample lady knows your name and your secrets.
4️⃣ The Self-Checkout Supervisor — Scans one item, calls the attendant, scans another, calls the attendant. You age a full decade behind them.

Tag the friend who is #1 (they won't admit it).
